fields.description: one short line a 3B model can read
fields.side_effects: list of effects. empty means read-only
fields.agent_may_invoke: false until the execution broker is unlocked for this id
fields.executor: who actually performs it today: broker-read, poller_job, or none
fields.requires_confirmation: true when a human must agree before any future unlock
fields.permission: optional. READ | DIAGNOSE | GENERATE_WORK_ORDER | BUILD | MODIFY_FILES | COMMIT | PUSH | CREATE_PR | MERGE | DEPLOY | RECOVER | COMMUNICATE. kind stays the effect class.
fields.monitor_gate: optional. Root Monitor gate id the broker reads. A missing gate denies this capability when its permission is not READ or DIAGNOSE.
